# Transpose a 2 × 3 Array

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

A two-dimensional Array is distinct from the Matrix type. Transpose swaps the two dimensions and preserves every exact element in row-major order.

## What this example demonstrates

A two-dimensional Array is distinct from the Matrix type. Transpose swaps the two dimensions and preserves every exact element in row-major order.
